description: Save a consented request for a selected professional or operator review. This sends a REAL message to a real small business, so call it only when the person has clearly asked to be contacted by 905 Trades and has given you their own name and their own phone number or email. Never guess or invent contact details. Plain words only, no links. One request per person per day. If it is urgent, give them the phone number instead.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true: the customer has asked to be contacted by this business about this request.

details.description: What they need, in the customer's own terms. Plain text, no links, 800 characters at most.

email.description: The customer's email address. Give this or phone.

phone.description: The customer's phone number, ten digits. Give this or email.

preferred_time.description: When they would like to be contacted or visited, if they said.

service.description: What they need: flooring = flooring; garage-doors = garage doors; carpet-cleaning = carpet and upholstery cleaning; renovations = renovations; plumbing-gas-heating = plumbing, gas and heating; property-maintenance = property maintenance; rental-turnovers = rental turnovers; commercial-property = commercial property; truck-parts = used ram truck parts; mortgages = mortgage introductions.

town.description: Town or postal code where the work is.
